title: SPQR Multi-Object Dataset
description: In 2023, SPQR Team developed a real-time multi-class detection system for the NAO V6 using state-of-the-art structural pruning techniques applied to YOLOv7-tiny. The system detects balls, goalposts, and robots in a single forward pass, balancing speed and accuracy within the computational constraints of the NAO platform. We released the annotated SPQR Multi-Object Dataset containing over 4000 images from RoboCup SPL matches.
